name.text: Bright Horizons Bank Street Day Nursery and Preschool

description.text:
Bank Street Day Nursery and Preschool (formally Little Unicorns) is based on the Canary Wharf complex within walking distance of the Canary Wharf Jubilee line station, ideally located for commuting parents and with buggy storage available.

Part of Bright Horizons Family, which received the Royal Society for the Prevention of Accidents (ROSPA) award in April 2016, Bank Street Nursery is located in a tranquil setting within the Canary Wharf complex.

The nursery offers a wide variety of engaging activities, which encourage children to learn and explore in a home from home environment. Children are well-prepared for the transition to school with the unique Bright Horizons Ready for School Programmes, including Growing Readers, Writers and Mathematicians.
